text:
Evan T: Quick proposal we should run a mid-cycle spot-check of ~50 random review forms to validate calibration consistency across managers. Not a performance audit, more of a norming exercise. Thoughts?
Lina M: +1. Might be helpful to focus on the 'impact' vs 'execution' scoring discrepancies we've seen before. Keep it lightweight though.
Arjun P: Agree. Recommend anonymizing names and levels so reviewers are evaluating content not reputation. Also suggest pairing managers: each form gets two independent ratings, then we reconcile if scores differ >1 band.
Sofia R: Operational ask: what's the timeline? We don't want to overload reviewers during calibration week.
Evan T: Timeline idea: export sample set by Mon EOD, run the spot-check the following Wed-Fri (3 days), reconciliation session Thu afternoon for any high-disagreement cases. Results shared as aggregate guidance, not person-level callouts.
Arjun P: That sounds reasonable. Can Juno produce a randomized export that excludes anyone flagged as "sensitive" (LOA, legal, comp escalations)?
Juno (HR Bot): I can. Parameters I need: sample_size, exclude_tags (comma-separated), anonymize (Y/N), assign_pairs (Y/N). Default sample_size=50. If you confirm, I will post the export link and create a short rating form for reviewers.
Lina M: Let's set sample_size=60 to get better coverage across teams. Exclude tags = LOA, legal, comp_escalation. Anonymize=Y. Assign_pairs=Y.
Evan T: Good call on 60. Also request that reviewers mark whether they relied on prior-year feedback in their rating (Y/N) so we can measure anchoring.
Sofia R: Who will be the reconciliation leads? We should pick neutral senior ops/people-ops folks, not the manager of the person in question.
Evan T: Proposed leads: Lina and me as primary reconcilers, Arjun as tie-break. We'll publish the reconciliation rubric: thresholds for flagging (score delta >1 band or qualitative mismatch on growth vs performance).
Arjun P: Also, please record the reconciliation notes as aggregate reasons so we can update the calibration rubric doc. We want repeatable guidance.
Lina M: Small logistics: add a 30-minute training drop-in on Tue to walk managers through the rating form and rubric. Make it optional but encouraged.
Juno (HR Bot): Noted. Creating export with sample_size=60, exclude_tags=[LOA,legal,comp_escalation], anonymize=Y, assign_pairs=Y. Volunteer reviewer pool ska: people tagged as "calibration_experienced" will be prioritized for assignments. I will post the volunteer sign-up and calendar invites once export is ready.
Evan T: Action items: (1) Juno to generate export and rating form, (2) People Ops to send volunteer sign-up and run 30m training Tue 09:00 PT, (3) Spot-check Wed-Fri, (4) Reconciliation Thu 15:00 PT, (5) Publish aggregated guidance by next Mon.
Sofia R: One more ask: include a short anonymity FAQ so managers know this is about norms not punitive.
Lina M: I'll draft the FAQ blurb. Evan/TBD will review before posting.
Evan T: OK I'll wait 2 hours for objections; if none I'll confirm with Juno. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
